description: Values of the systematic review that are not in analysis_output.json. Extracted once by extract_numbers.py from the internal review report, the protocol and the human-check sample; read by paper/p1/make_numbers.py.

disagreement_pairs.source: internal review report, Section 2, 'Disagreements' (pairs of paper and variable)

postcheck_corrections.source: internal review report, Section 2, 'Post-check correction' (papers; see coding/adjudication_log_3_postcheck.csv)

code_read_papers.source: internal review report, Section 2, 'Code read' (papers, by at least one coder)

human_check_sample_size.source: human-check sample file (rows; the same number is stated in Section 2 of the internal review report)

human_check_percent.source: internal review report, Section 2 (planned human check of a random share)

report_n_few_shot.source: internal review report, Section 3 (few-shot count; checked against analysis_output.json)

inaccessible_worst_case_percent.source: internal review report, Section 3 (share of A + A' among all reduced-label papers if no inaccessible paper is A/A')

inaccessible_best_case_percent.source: internal review report, Section 3 (share of A + A' among all reduced-label papers if every inaccessible paper is A/A')

old_audit_total_papers.source: internal review report, Section 6 heading (papers in the earlier audit)

old_audit_reduced_label_papers.source: internal review report, Section 6 heading (earlier-audit papers with reduced labels)

old_audit_few_shot_k.source: internal review report, Section 6, item 2 (earlier estimate, A + A' few-shot papers)

old_audit_few_shot_n.source: internal review report, Section 6, item 2 (earlier estimate, few-shot papers)

old_audit_few_shot_percent.source: internal review report, Section 6, item 2 (earlier estimate, percent)
